He has a 15-pack-year smoking history, a history of heroin abuse, and is on methadone. His family history is notable for parathyroid adenoma in his father. His temperature is 98.8°F (37.1°C), blood pressure is 125/80 mmHg, pulse is 78/min, and respirations are 18/min. This patient’s symptoms are most likely due to elevations in a substance with which of the following functions?
